model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the relationship between Cache Ratio and GSM8K Accuracy under two conditions, denoted as "No Delay" and "Delay". The x-axis is labeled "Cache Ratio" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.5, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "GSM8K Accuracy" and utilizes a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 80, displaying tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot contains two lines. The line representing "No Delay" is depicted as a solid blue line with circular markers. It begins at an x-value of approximately 0.25 with a y-value of roughly 72, then shows a gradual decline to a y-value of 61 at x ≈ 0.37. After this point, it exhibits a sharp, continuous drop, passing through a y-value of 35 at x ≈ 0.43, 11 at x ≈ 0.47, and concluding at x ≈ 0.48 with a final y-value near 3. The line representing "Delay" is shown as a solid greyish-green line with square markers. It starts at an x-value of approximately 0.24 with a y-value near 74 and maintains a highly stable, nearly flat trend across the x-axis. It records data points of approximately 75 at x ≈ 0.36, 74 at x ≈ 0.43, and 75 at x ≈ 0.46, before ending at x ≈ 0.48 with a y-value of roughly 74.
